categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinhao Photoelectricity Technology Co., Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of glass protective screens used in smartphones, tablets, wearable devices, and automotive display equipment. The company also operates in photovoltaic equipment and components, and energy storage systems through its subsidiaries. It has expanded into smart energy and integrated energy storage solutions via investments in related companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced glass processing technologies including ultra-high temperature tempering, ultrasonic cleaning, precision silk-screen printing, and coating processes such as AG (Anti-Glare), AR (Anti-Reflection), DLC (Diamond-Like Carbon), and AF (Anti-Fingerprint) coatings. It has developed automated production lines featuring AGV robots, mechanical arms, and AOI optical inspection, integrating AI and big data for quality control and process optimization. The firm also invests in R&D for microcrystalline glass, 3D curved glass, laser welding, and inkjet printing technologies tailored for high-performance glass protective covers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major display panel manufacturers such as BOE, Tianma Microelectronics, Samsung Display, and CSOT, with end products supplied to leading smartphone brands like Vivo, OPPO, Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, Honor, Lenovo, and Transsion. The company serves the consumer electronics market (smartphones, tablets, wearables), automotive electronics (in-car displays), and emerging AIoT devices including AR/VR glasses and smart home products. It also targets photovoltaic and energy storage markets through its subsidiaries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Huangshi, Enshi, Chuzhou, and other inland cities, leveraging regional advantages for cost and policy benefits. It has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Vietnam, Germany, Spain, and other international locations. The company actively pursues expansion in domestic and overseas markets, including Europe, Africa, and Latin America, especially for photovoltaic and energy storage products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinhao Photoelectricity operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing glass protective covers and components for downstream display panel makers and terminal device manufacturers. It sources raw materials such as specialty glass from upstream suppliers and provides customized glass solutions directly to panel and device manufacturers. The company also extends upstream into energy storage system development through equity investments.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in glass materials and processing, focusing on enhancing product strength, optical performance, and manufacturing automation. Key R&D directions include ultra-thin glass, microcrystalline glass, advanced coating technologies (3A coatings), laser welding, and inkjet printing for wearables. It aims to expand applications into automotive displays, AR/VR devices, medical equipment, and smart home products. The firm also invests in smart manufacturing, AI-driven quality control, and energy-efficient production to improve competitiveness and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized glass protective screens and related components to display panel manufacturers and terminal device makers. The company operates on a build-to-order and make-to-order production model, with sales governed by framework agreements and specific purchase orders. It also earns income from photovoltaic equipment sales, energy storage solutions, and investment returns from subsidiaries. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to non-operating revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xinhao Photoelectricity is one of the leading domestic suppliers of glass protective covers in China, competing with major panel manufacturers and glass suppliers such as Corning and Schott. It holds a strong market position with deep partnerships with top-tier panel makers and smartphone brands. The company differentiates itself through advanced automation, comprehensive R&D capabilities, and a broad product portfolio covering 2D to 3D curved glass. It faces competition from both domestic and international players, especially in photovoltaic and energy storage sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.69 billion, a slight decline of 2.72% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -353 million due to increased costs and market pressures. The company’s total assets reached over RMB 5.2 billion, with equity of about RMB 2.3 billion. Despite recent losses, the company is investing heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, aiming for a turnaround and sustainable growth driven by new product lines and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinhao Photoelectricity emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced glass protective covers with superior optical clarity, durability, and customized coatings tailored to client needs. Its competitive edge lies in automated intelligent manufacturing, integrated supply chain collaboration, and continuous innovation in materials and processes. The company offers comprehensive solutions from raw material development to finished product integration, supporting major global brands with reliable supply and cutting-edge technology. Its strategic focus on emerging markets like automotive displays and AIoT devices further differentiates its product offerings.
